keywords.description: Please specify 3 keywords in decreasing order of importance.

enum: Cognitive Modeling & Knowledge Representation for Robots
Field Robotics (e.g., Aerial, Agricultural, Construction, Space, Underwater Robotics)

pdf.description: Please upload the PDF of your paper. The maximum file size is 100MB. Can be left blank for the abstract registration, but needs to be uploaded before the paper submission deadline.

supplementary_material.description: All supplementary material must be self-contained and zipped into a single file. Note that supplementary material will be visible to reviewers, so ensure all material is anonymized. The maximum file size is 100MB. The deadline for supplementary material is one week after the paper submission deadline.

confirmation_of_submission_requirements.description: Before submitting any paper, please carefully read the submission instructions found here: https://roboticsconference.org/information/authorinfo/. If any of these requirements are not fulfilled, your submission will be rejected and will not be reviewed.

enum: I have carefully read the submission instructions and prepared my paper accordingly.
I have included a "Limitations" section in my paper.
This work contains novel research that was not previously published or submitted elsewhere.

additional_requirements_for_science_or_s.description: Before you submit a Science/Systems paper, please make sure that the following requirements are met. If any of these requirements are not fulfilled, your submission will be rejected and will not be reviewed. These are not required for Demo papers which are reviewed single blind.

enum: I have anonymized my paper for double blind review.
There are no external links in my paper.

additional_requirements_for_demo_papers.description: Before you submit a Demo paper, please make sure that the following requirements are met. If any of these requirements are not fulfilled, your submission will be rejected and will not be reviewed. These are not required for Science/Systems papers.

enum: The title of my demo paper starts with "Demonstrating" (e.g. "Demonstrating Large Language Models on Robots").
